answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own walnut record, and its own share of the river quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The sonnet ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 1215 identities would post 4529 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
